implementation_choices: Store timeout count: +1 per underlying timed_out the store's drain or flush observes (file busy + console timed_out still counts one); writers' own flushTimeouts are excluded from the store sum
A line reaching a writer after its close latched is counted droppedRecords; nothing pending is folded (queue empty once close returns)
Off-main UI hand-off: bounded by maxEntries with the ring's own amortised trim (maxEntries + trimSlack); evictions counted in historyEvicted (internal), not record loss
LogSink.flush(timeout:) default (true) left as it was; only drain defaults to unavailable
The app tail's busy after a host timed_out is expected and reported; nothing retries
honest_scope: A drain outcome is a fact about queues only; neither typed event nor its derived line is claimed persisted, and nothing waits after them
Close on a Settings toggle still blocks the main turn until the writer's admitted writes end, as before
The app-level tests use the internal composition wrapper over the authoritative guard; no public, live-host or test-only production hook

No new queue, executor, capacity, dependency, registry, public access or TODO; package additions are the planned LogSink.drain, ConsoleLogSink.write(line:), RotatingByteWriter members and the typed/wire values. No actor retag
